title: Honeycob Sudoku No,509-001
author: kazu3
rules:
Fill every white cell with a digit from 1 to 5. Leave grey cells empty.

Digits must not repeat in any horizontal or vertical run of white cells, even in runs shorter than five cells. Grey cells and the outer boundary separate runs; thick lines do not.

Each run of five white cells and each five-cell region outlined by thick lines must contain the digits 1 to 5 exactly once.

The small letters A to E mark the cells used for the solution code. Fill these cells with digits as usual.
solutionCode: Enter the digits in the cells marked A, B, C, D and E, in that order, without spaces (5 digits).
